data.one_liner: A development dependency to generate secure dotenv file for flutter_secure_dotenv package.
data.what_it_does: Acts as a development dependency and code generator for the flutter_secure_dotenv package to help manage environment variables securely. It processes configuration files and generates the necessary code during build time.
use_when: You are using the flutter_secure_dotenv package in your Flutter project
You need to generate secure dotenv files during the build process
avoid_when: You prefer manual environment variable management without code generation
strengths: Integrated with build_runner and source_gen workflows
data.setup_notes: Add as a development dependency alongside build_runner and configure for your flutter_secure_dotenv setup.
